text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1: Quality regression detected for model rdx-large-v2 in region us-central1. Alerting threshold: hallucination_rate > 2% over 10m window and user_decay_metric spike. Triggered at 2490001234. Tags: model=rdx-large-v2, env=prod, region=us-central1

alice_sre: Acknowledged. I'm on the pager. Seeing elevated user error reports and increased generation variance on the dashboards. Repro steps in logs look like longer context leading to wrong factual assertions. Will pull logs + samplings now.

ben_runtime: Thanks @alice_sre. Quick note: canary traffic to rdx-large-v2 in europe is fine, issue looks isolated to us-central1. Could be a bad kernel or quantization path on that host pool. Checking infra metrics and kernel versions.

carla_ml: Adding ML context: evaluation suite shows small but consistent drift on the safety filter and answer faithfulness checks for rdx-large-v2 vs rdx-large-v1 for recent prompts. Not huge but aligns with customer complaints about hallucinations. Possible model packaging mismatch (tokenizer/merges).

derek_product: Need to surface impact: Support flagged 6 enterprise tenants in us-central1 experiencing increased rejections and hallucinations in the last 30m. Not yet widespread but must communicate proactively. Drafting status page and customer note.

emma_support: Draft customer note (internal review):
```
Subject: Brief service notice — temporary degradation for text-generation (us-central1)
Customers: Some requests routed to rdx-large-v2 in us-central1 are returning inconsistent results. We are actively investigating and have applied mitigation to route traffic to an earlier verified model. No action required from you. We will send updates by 30-minute cadence and follow up with a post-incident summary.
```
Please edit for tone/accuracy.

ben_runtime: Proposed live mitigation (ops plan):
1) Route new requests in us-central1 away from rdx-large-v2 to rdx-large-v1 (traffic split 100% -> v1)
2) Roll back the faulty deployment in the us-central1 pool and re-run packaging checks
3) Keep canary in other regions untouched and monitor metrics for 20m

Commands (internal only):
```
# route traffic for model alias
rdcli traffic-route set --alias rdx-large --region us-central1 --to rdx-large-v1 --percent 100 --force
# rollback deployment
rdcli deploy rollback --region us-central1 --model rdx-large-v2 --to rdx-large-v1
# verify
rdcli metrics tail --model rdx-large --region us-central1 --window 10m
```
Note: these require oncall SRE + runtime lead signoff.

frank_commops: Internal comms template for status page + Slack:
- Status page short: "We are investigating degraded quality for text-generation in us-central1; mitigation in progress."
- Public updates cadence: initial (now), update in 30m, resolution and postmortem within 48 hours.
- PB: do not name customers in public post. Use Customer Success to send targeted emails for impacted accounts.

alice_sre: Executing mitigation now: running the traffic-route command. Will confirm when routing completes. Will capture timestamps for rollback and maintain an action log.

alice_sre: (system) Ran: `rdcli traffic-route set --alias rdx-large --region us-central1 --to rdx-large-v1 --percent 100 --force` — API returned 202 accepted. Routing change propagated to edge in ~18s.

carla_ml: Great. I'll hold on rollback until we see routing stability for 10m and check for any regressions from routing change. Also will snapshot failing samples to aid postmortem.

emma_support: Sending targeted customer emails now (internal copy):
```
Hi <Customer>,
We detected intermittent quality issues for text-generation requests served from us-central1. We've switched traffic to a verified model and you should see normal behavior now. We're actively investigating root cause and will follow up with a post-incident summary.
Apologies for the disruption.
— Redwood Inference Support
```
Adding cc: CSMs.

derek_product: Status page draft (short):
"Investigation: We are investigating degraded output quality for text-generation in us-central1. Mitigation applied (traffic routed to a verified model). We will provide updates every 30 minutes"

frank_commops: Internal channel post for wider org: please use the below template when copying to #general: 
```
Short: We detected degraded model outputs in us-central1 for rdx-large-v2. Traffic has been routed to the previous verified model and mitigation is in progress. Engineering teams are investigating root cause.
If you support affected customers, see #support for the customer template.
```

alice_sre: Quick ask for approvals: @carla_ml you ok with full rollback command once we confirm no impact from routing? @ben_runtime can you confirm infra patches we might need to test before re-deploying v2?

carla_ml: Approve rollback when routing is stable for 10m. Will provide a narrowed test suite for the re-deploy (tokenizer checks + safety regression tests).

ben_runtime: I'll run package sanity checks and kernel compatibility scan on the us-central1 pool. If we see quantization mismatch we'll flag and block re-deploy.

oncall_next: I'm taking the next on-call window at 2490001299. Handoff note: mitigation in place, routing to rdx-large-v1, monitoring active. Please ping me for escalations.

alice_sre: Thanks @oncall_next — logging final actions:
- Mitigation: traffic routed to rdx-large-v1 in us-central1 at 2490001242
- Customer emails sent to flagged tenants at 2490001260
- Org status posted to #incident-updates and status page draft published (initial)
- Next steps: infra packaging audit (ben_runtime), ML regression suite (carla_ml), postmortem owner: derek_product

alice_sre: Closing initial handoff. Will update thread in 30m with metric check. If anything changes escalate to P0. :white_check_mark:
